name: Carson-Newman University
academic_ranking: Private Baptist-affiliated liberal arts university in Jefferson City, TN. Ranked by U.S. News & World Report at #358 (tie) of 395 among National Universities (per Wikipedia). Endowment approximately $75.5 million (2024).
financial_aid: 2026-27 full-time undergraduate tuition & fees are $42,500/year ($21,250/semester). Total billable cost of attendance (tuition, fees, room and meals) is approximately $55,100-$55,300/year. School states its tuition + fees are about $3,000 less than the median for similar colleges. Average financial aid received by undergraduate freshmen was $33,769 in 2022 (includes loans). Comprehensive scholarships, grants, loans, and work-study available based on need, academic ability, and special talents. New 2025-26 students who are Federal Pell recipients receive free standard on-campus housing. Source: cn.edu/tuition and cn.edu/financial-aid, checked 2026-07.
facilities_notes: Softball program is part of the Carson-Newman Athletic Department (2130 S. Branner Ave., Jefferson City, TN 37760). A specific named home softball stadium/field was not found on public pages checked (softball index, roster, schedule, coaches; cneagles.com). Note: NCAA Division II member fielding 21 varsity teams; campus baseball venue is the Silver Diamond Baseball Complex (per Wikipedia).
program_reputation: NCAA Division II softball program competing in the South Atlantic Conference (SAC). Eagles athletics. No specific national ranking or recent postseason accolades were confirmed from the public pages checked.
notes: Data sourced live 2026-07 from cneagles.com Sidearm site (softball coaches, roster, schedule pages) and cn.edu tuition/financial-aid pages, plus Wikipedia for academic ranking and division/conference confirmation.
